title: SQL DBA  SailPoint
description:
SQL DBA SailPoint 
 Mode : Remote Shift: rotation shift 4PM IST to 1AM IST and 12:00AM IST to 9:00AM IST. Notice : Immediate to 25 days 
 Job Summary 
We are seeking an experienced SQL Database Administrator (DBA) with 5 to 8+ years of hands-on experience, strong expertise in Microsoft SQL Server and SailPoint IdentityIQ to manage, optimize, secure, and support databases underlying enterprise Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platforms. The role will be responsible for database infrastructure, performance tuning, high availability, disaster recovery, security, capacity management, automation, and operational support for SailPoint environments.
The ideal candidate will work closely with SailPoint application, infrastructure, security, and development teams to ensure database reliability, scalability, performance, and compliance across on-premises and cloud environments.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. SailPoint Database Administration & Infrastructure 
 Install, configure, administer, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server instances supporting SailPoint IdentityIQ databases and related IGA workloads across on-premises and cloud environments. Manage SailPoint database schemas, configuration, migrations, and database changes required for platform upgrades and releases. Ensure SQL Server and database configurations are optimized for SailPoint workloads and enterprise standards. Support database connectivity between SailPoint application servers and backend SQL Server environments. 2. SailPoint Performance Tuning & Troubleshooting 
 Monitor and optimize SQL Server performance during high-volume SailPoint operations, including Identity Refresh, account/target aggregation, provisioning, certifications, entitlement processing, role processing, reporting, and workflow execution. Analyze and resolve blocking, deadlocks, lock contention, long-running transactions, connection-pool issues, CPU/IO bottlenecks, and transaction timeouts. Optimize complex T-SQL queries generated by SailPoint tasks, reporting processes, and custom integrations. Develop and maintain effective indexing and statistics strategies for high-volume SailPoint tables. Establish performance baselines for critical SailPoint tasks and identify performance degradation following application, configuration, or infrastructure changes. Perform root-cause analysis for SailPoint database-related failures, including transaction, session, locking, and timeout issues. Collaborate with SailPoint L3/application teams to determine whether performance issues originate from SQL Server, SailPoint configuration, application servers, custom code, or task concurrency. 3. High Availability & Disaster Recovery 
 Configure and administer SQL Server high-availability solutions, including Always On Availability Groups and Failover Cluster Instances (FCI), as required. Implement and maintain backup and recovery strategies, including full, differential, and transaction log backups. Develop, automate, and test point-in-time recovery procedures. Conduct periodic database restore and disaster recovery exercises to validate recovery readiness and support compliance requirements. Maintain appropriate RPO/RTO objectives for business-critical SailPoint environments. 4. Database Security, Auditing & Compliance 
 Implement least-privilege access controls for SailPoint service accounts, database administrators, application teams, and reporting tools. Secure sensitive identity and access-related data using appropriate SQL Server encryption technologies, including TDE and encryption in transit. Review database permissions, access patterns, and privilege escalation activities. Maintain database auditing and logging to support SOX, HIPAA, GDPR, and other applicable compliance requirements. Partner with security and compliance teams during database security assessments and audits. 5. SailPoint Connector & Integration Support 
 Design, implement, and support SQL Server schemas, views, stored procedures, and database objects used by SailPoint JDBC/SQL connectors. Support database integrations used for identity aggregation, provisioning, and target-system connectivity. Assist SailPoint developers and application teams with query optimization, schema design, and database-related integration issues. Troubleshoot database connectivity, authentication, timeout, locking, and performance issues affecting SailPoint integrations. 6. Database Monitoring, Automation & Maintenance 
 Implement and maintain proactive monitoring for SQL Server health, performance, availability, and capacity. Configure alerts for critical conditions such as CPU and memory pressure, deadlocks, failed jobs, connection issues, storage constraints, and transaction-log growth. Develop PowerShell and T-SQL automation for health checks, maintenance, integrity validation, alerting, and operational tasks. Perform routine database maintenance, including index maintenance, statistics updates, integrity checks, and job monitoring. Apply SQL Server cumulative updates, security patches, and other maintenance releases in accordance with enterprise change-management processes. Maintain dashboards and reporting for key database health and performance metrics. 7. Capacity, Growth & Data Retention Management 
 Monitor growth of SailPoint tables containing audit events, workflow data, task results, identity information, provisioning transactions, account data, and other high-volume operational records. Identify abnormal database and table growth and recommend appropriate retention, archival, purge, and indexing strategies. Forecast requirements for database storage, transaction logs, TempDB, CPU, memory, and I/O based on identity population and SailPoint workload growth. Analyze database impact from operational backlogs, including workflow events and identity-processing activities. Conduct database capacity and performance impact assessments before major activities such as mass Identity Refreshes, full aggregations, bulk provisioning, migrations, and production cleanup. Proactively prevent performance degradation caused by excessive historical or audit data. 8. SailPoint Workload & Task Scheduling Coordination 
 Partner with SailPoint application teams to optimize scheduling of database-intensive tasks and prevent excessive concurrent workloads. Analyze database utilization during Identity Refresh, aggregation, certification generation, reporting, maintenance, provisioning, and background workflow activities. Recommend scheduling, concurrency, partitioning, batch-size, and task-server distribution changes when SailPoint workloads create excessive database CPU, I/O, locking, or transaction-log utilization. Provide database performance and capacity guidance for large-scale SailPoint operations and application changes. Required Qualifications 
 Strong experience administering Microsoft SQL Server in enterprise production environments. Hands-on experience supporting SailPoint IdentityIQ databases and SailPoint application workloads. Strong knowledge of T-SQL, SQL Server performance tuning, indexing, statistics, execution plans, locking, blocking, and deadlock analysis. Experience with SQL Server backup, recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery technologies. Experience with SQL Server security, permissions, encryption, auditing, and compliance controls. Experience supporting database integrations using JDBC/SQL and stored procedures. Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills in complex application/database environments. Experience with PowerShell and T-SQL scripting for database automation and administration. Knowledge of database monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, and performance management. Strong communication and collaboration skills with application, infrastructure, security, and development teams. Preferred Qualifications 
 SailPoint IdentityIQ administration or production support experience. Experience supporting large-scale Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) environments. Experience with SQL Server Always On Availability Groups and/or Failover Cluster Instances. Experience supporting SQL Server in cloud environments such as Azure or AWS. Familiarity with SailPoint task architecture, aggregation, Identity Refresh, provisioning, certification, workflow, and connector processing. Experience working in regulated environments with SOX, HIPAA, GDPR, or similar compliance requirements. Relevant Microsoft SQL Server and/or SailPoint certifications are a plus.

Key Skills: Database Administrator (DBA),Sailpoint,Microsoft SQL Server and SailPoint IdentityIQ,Infrastructure,Performance Tuning & Troubleshooting,Serv,Performance,SQL DBA

title: Senior / Lead Oracle Exadata Database Administrator
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Oracle Exadata DBA with deep expertise in Exadata platform administration, RAC, ASM, and Data Guard. The candidate will independently own the database track of a migration program engaging with the customer to gather requirements, documenting current, intermediate, and target-state database environments, and producing HLD/LLD designs for Exadata migrations. 

 Key Responsibilities Exadata Architecture & Administration • Administer and optimize Oracle Exadata Database Machine environments, including compute nodes, storage cells, and InfiniBand/RoCE fabric. • Develop HLD, LLD, and technical architecture documentation for Exadata database environments. 
 • Manage Oracle RAC clusters, Automatic Storage Management (ASM), and Grid Infrastructure. • Design and maintain Data Guard configurations for high availability and disaster recovery. Migration & Requirement Gathering • Capture database migration requirements from the customer, including sizing, downtime windows, and dependencies. • Document current-state database environment (platform, version, size, dependencies, integrations). • Define intermediate and target-state Exadata architecture and migration approach. • Lead database migrations to/from Exadata using RMAN, Data Pump, Oracle GoldenGate, and cross-platform transportable tablespaces. • Develop migration runbooks, cutover plans, validation scripts, and rollback procedures. Platform Operations • Perform Exadata quarterly patching using OEDA/patchmgr, including storage cell, compute node, and InfiniBand switch patching. • Perform performance tuning, SQL optimization, and capacity planning across the Exadata estate. • Manage backup and recovery strategy using RMAN integrated with enterprise backup platforms. Documentation & Leadership • Produce architecture diagrams, SOPs, runbooks, and customer-facing design documentation. • Act as the technical SME for Oracle Exadata technologies; mentor engineers and lead governance reviews. Required Skills • Oracle Database (19c/21c) • Oracle Exadata Database Machine • Oracle RAC & Grid Infrastructure • Automatic Storage Management (ASM) • Oracle Data Guard • RMAN backup & recovery • Oracle GoldenGate • Exadata patching (OEDA, patchmgr) • Oracle Enterprise Manager • Linux administration (Oracle Linux) Preferred Experience 
 • 8+ years of Oracle DBA experience, with L3/L4 Exadata platform expertise. • Proven experience leading database migrations to/from Exadata as part of data center or platform transformation programs. • Experience authoring HLD/LLD and current/intermediate/target-state documentation for customer delivery. 
 Oracle certifications (OCP/OCE Exadata) preferred.
